episodes.title: The Dispatcher
episodes.summary: A storm in the sleepy town of Port McKenna reveals a long-buried clue about a missing girl.

episodes.title: The Call
episodes.summary: Convinced he can flush out Maggie's kidnapper, Ian forms a plan.

episodes.title: The Lie
episodes.summary: A closer examination of the call turns Ian's world inside out.

episodes.title: The Truth
episodes.summary: Pressure mounts and relationships are tested as Ian leads the police to Henry and Jenna's door.

episodes.title: The Prophet
episodes.summary: Henry and Jenna's past holds the key to Maggie's disappearance.
